newsitem.title: UK: EBRD hires NatWest banker for funding department.
newsitem.headline: EBRD hires NatWest banker for funding department.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) said in a statement on Tuesday it had appointed Isabelle Laurent as deputy head of funding.
Laurent was hired from NatWest Markets, where she was director of debt and derivatives marketing, the statement said.
Laurent will report to the EBRD's head of funding, Ayesha Shah.
"The EBRD's funding stategy is based on reverse enquiry and is exclusively driven by investor appetite," the bank's treasurer, Mark Cutis, said in the statement.

"We are obliged to look for new markets and structures in response to demand from our investors. In that context, Mrs Laurent's extensive structuring and general capital markets background, coupled with her Asian expertise, will provide an additional dimension to our funding activities."
